request.query: What is the default value, limit, requirement, or documented behavior of `jest.resetAllMocks`?
request.instructions: A passage answers only if it itself states a concrete value, limit, version, or rule for `jest.resetAllMocks`. A passage that only mentions the name, or only uses it in an example without stating a rule, does not answer.

documents.title: docs/CLI.md > Reference > `--resetMocks`
documents.text:
### `--resetMocks`

Automatically reset mock state before every test. Equivalent to calling [`jest.resetAllMocks()`](JestObjectAPI.md#jestresetallmocks) before each test. This will lead to any mocks having their fake implementations removed but does not restore their initial implementation.

documents.title: docs/Configuration.md > Reference > `resetMocks` \[boolean]
documents.text:
### `resetMocks` \[boolean]

Default: `false`

Automatically reset mock state before every test. Equivalent to calling [`jest.resetAllMocks()`](JestObjectAPI.md#jestresetallmocks) before each test. This will lead to any mocks having their fake implementations removed but does not restore their initial implementation.

documents.title: docs/JestObjectAPI.md > Mock Functions > `jest.resetAllMocks()`
documents.text:
### `jest.resetAllMocks()`

Resets the state of all mocks. Equivalent to calling [`.mockReset()`](MockFunctionAPI.md#mockfnmockreset) on every mocked function.

Returns the `jest` object for chaining.
